import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import json,subprocess
f=json.loads(Path('inputs/review-r1-family-comparison.json').read_text())['rows']
a=json.loads(Path('inputs/accepted57-scopes.json').read_text())['records']
p=json.loads(Path('inputs/prior39-scopes.json').read_text());p=p['prior30']+p['next9']
out=[]
for index in [0,1,56,57,95]:
 row=f[index]; records=a if row['group']=='accepted57' else p
 matches=[r for r in records if r.get('mathdb_id',r.get('number'))==row['key']]
 assert len(matches)==1,(row['key'],len(matches))
 record=matches[0];scope=record[row['actual_scope_field']];assert scope==row['actual_scope']
 item={'key':row['key'],'group':row['group'],'actual_field':row['actual_scope_field'],'actual_scope':scope,'comparison':row['comparison'],'comparison_matches_source':True};out.append(item);print(json.dumps(item,ensure_ascii=False))
r=subprocess.run(['python3','-I','-B',str(Path.cwd()/'write_lane.py'),'family-spotcheck.json'],input=json.dumps(out,indent=2),text=True,capture_output=True);assert r.returncode==0;print(r.stdout)
